hackett2016_cdc19_flux_response.name: Native S. cerevisiae Cdc19-associated pyruvate-kinase flux response to PEP, ADP, fructose-1,6-bisphosphate and Cdc19 abundance
hackett2016_cdc19_flux_response.dependency_to_test: A fructose-1,6-bisphosphate dependence beyond substrate/product availability, measured abundance, batch/acquisition-clock effects and the frozen supplied rate template. Functional form must be selected from distinct candidates using real train/development observations only.
required_direct_evidence: source-bound native flux observations with audited flux-estimation uncertainty and enzyme/reaction attribution
jointly measured metabolite and protein inputs in the same biological contexts
independent Cdc19 activity-response observations at matched regulator and assay conditions
hackett2016_cdc19_flux_response.normalization: Keep canonical flux per dry biomass; relative protein may be a covariate only with a frozen training reference. Neither division by relative protein nor a fitted detector gain produces intrinsic turnover.
hackett2016_cdc19_flux_response.scope: Conditional empirical native steady-state flux response within the source-verified strain, medium, growth, temperature, metabolite/protein ranges and flux-identifiability domain. Report the exact final contexts and observed training support; no extrapolation or causal regulator identification follows.
ineligible_if: flux cannot be attributed to the stated reaction/protein
source measurement or upstream fitting lineage is unresolved
input variation is confounded with acquisition time/batch
group, uncertainty or physical-conservation requirements cannot be met

granados2018_sfp1_carbon_localization.name: Native S. cerevisiae Sfp1 nuclear-localization proxy response to a documented glucose downshift
granados2018_sfp1_carbon_localization.dependency_to_test: An input-conditioned Sfp1 localization response beyond absolute experimental clock, training-constant and affine-input fits, and a frozen first-order/source-template response. Real crossed onsets/doses must identify input response separately from elapsed acquisition time.
required_direct_evidence: native Sfp1 max5 and median fluorescence or a source-audited unnormalized nucLoc ratio
complete biological experiment identities and acquisition/input schedules
independent matched nuclear-marker observation supporting localization
granados2018_sfp1_carbon_localization.normalization: Use raw nucLoc=max5/median with source-audited positive denominators and fixed instrument/background adapter. nucLocNorm is prohibited unless its exact transformation is fixed without final-trace statistics and independently audited before fitting. No peak alignment, per-final-trace centering, normalization by final mean/max/min, or treating absent-cell nulls as zero.
granados2018_sfp1_carbon_localization.scope: Conditional empirical response of the Sfp1 max5/median imaging observable in the verified reporter strain, instrument, segmentation, medium, glucose schedules and time domain. This is not an absolute nuclear fraction, transcription rate, Hog1 phosphorylation, metabolic flux, enzyme mechanism or universal stress law.
ineligible_if: rep1 copied across files is counted as independent
random cells/time points replace whole biological experiment splits
nuclear-marker support is the same deterministic target signal
input onset and absolute acquisition time remain confounded
source normalization or strain is unresolved
the verified experiment inventory cannot meet all group requirements

identifiability.estimand: The measured native observable's conditional response functional within the independently validated domain, not individual latent biochemical parameters.
identifiability.gauge_policy: Explicitly enumerate observationally equivalent activity, abundance, observation-gain, and transport-pool scalings. A fitted prior or fixed source parameter does not break a measurement gauge. Report unidentified latent directions even when the observable response is validated.
identifiability.causality_policy: Observational flux covariation cannot establish a causal allosteric mechanism. Even randomized glucose inputs identify the reporter response, not every latent molecular path. A stronger claim needs a separately preregistered intervention/absolute-calibration protocol and new independent outcomes.
identifiability.domain_policy: The authenticated source/custodian and registry jointly fix all eligible context fields and input ranges before fitting. Final experiments outside that domain are retained as failed applicability tests, not silently dropped or used to expand the claim.

current_missing_evidence: externally anchored pre-fit registration and protected current access ledger
authoritative acquired-data and exact measurement-unit/normalization receipts
closed independently audited ancestral fit/selection graph
whole-biological-component split with sufficient disjoint final, support and sham experiments
frozen selected form, competing models, error budgets and inference artifacts
one sealed final prediction/outcome evaluation on real observations
matched independently measured activity or localization-observation support
source-bound negative-control, gauge, clock, normalization and physical-consistency evidence
